map.质量（标准/检测/环保）综合评估：输入标准符合度、检测合格率与环保达标率，结合质: Quality (standard/testing/environmental) assessment: enter standard-conformance, test pass-rate and environmental compliance, weight them with QMS certification status for a scored verdict and improvement advice; for enterprise quality diagnosis.
map.体系自评：按标准符合度、检测合格率、环保达标率与认证加分算综合分: Self-assessment: compute the composite score from conformance, pass rate, environmental rate and certification bonus
map.改进建议：低分项对应推进体系认证或提升合格率: Improvement: low sub-scores point to pursuing certification or raising pass rates
map.总分=round(标准符合度×0.35+检测合格率×0.35+环保达标率×0.2: Total = round(conformance×0.35 + pass rate×0.35 + environmental×0.20 + certification bonus); bonus: ISO9001 +5, ISO14001 +5, dual +10, none 0. Grades: ≥95 A, ≥85 B, ≥75 C, ≥60 D, else E.
map.标准符合度 92%、检测合格率 95%、环保达标率 90%、持 ISO9001（: Conformance 92%, pass 95%, environmental 90%, ISO9001 (+5): total = round(92×0.35+95×0.35+90×0.20+5)=round(32.2+33.25+18+5)=round(88.45)=88 → grade B (excellent). If all three drop to 80% with no certification: total=round(28+28+16+0)=72 → grade D.
map.权重怎么来的？: Where do the weights come from?
map.为内部快速自评的经验加权（标准与检测各 0.35、环保 0.20、认证加分），非: They are empirical weights for a quick internal self-assessment (standard & testing 0.35 each, environmental 0.20, certification bonus), not a mandatory standard; adjust by industry and defer to certifying bodies for formal review.
map.认证加分最高多少？: What is the maximum certification bonus?
map.双体系认证（质量+环境）加 10 分最高；单体系加 5；无认证不加分。加分可把边: Dual-system (quality+environment) certification tops at +10; a single system +5; none +0. The bonus can lift a borderline grade by one level, but the three base metrics must still pass.
map.标准符合度反映企业执行国家/行业标准的程度: Standard conformance reflects how well a firm follows national/industry standards
map.检测合格率和环保达标率是质量保障核心指标: Test pass rate and environmental compliance are core QA metrics
